methods.name: OLS on rank-deficient and ill-conditioned designs: aliased regressors, rank, df, and the normal-equations / pivoted-QR choice
methods.reference: stats::lm (lm.fit, dqrdc2, tol = 1e-7); stats::summary.lm; stats::logLik; stats::AIC; stats::BIC; sandwich::vcovHC
quantities: HC0/HC1/HC3 SE on the identified columns
solve path per design (normal equations for Grunfeld and ols_year_trend, pivoted QR for Longley, ols_illcond and aliased designs)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 120 and 80: coefficients 1e-8 / 1e-6, SE and statistics 1e-6 / 1e-5 relative; ill-conditioned coefficients Tol::coef(80); ols_year_trend (n = 5000, normal equations) coefficients 1e-10, SE and statistics 1e-8 relative; Longley also 1e-10 (an accuracy check, not a path pin); counts exact

methods.name: Clustered (CR1), Newey-West and wild-bootstrap SEs on an aliased design
methods.reference: sandwich::vcovCL(cluster = ~cl, type = 'HC1'); sandwich::NeweyWest(lag = 4, prewhite = FALSE); sandwich::vcovHC(type = 'HC0') as the bootstrap expectation
quantities: NaN SE for the aliased column
bootstrap SE on the identified columns (Monte Carlo property, not R-pinned)
fixed-design bootstrap solve = refit by least squares
wild bootstrap SE (Rademacher, Mammen, Webb) within 10% of HC0 (Monte Carlo property, B = 2000, seeded; not R-pinned)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 120: SE 1e-6 relative; bootstrap: Monte Carlo property, 10% = 6 sd at B = 2000; fixed-design solve 1e-12 relative

methods.name: RESET test, type = princomp (and fitted, regressor), also on an aliased model
methods.reference: lmtest::resettest(power = 2:3 | 3, type = 'princomp' | 'fitted' | 'regressor'); stats::anova.lm of the augmented fit (aliased model)
quantities: RESET statistic, df, p (princomp, fitted, regressor; power 2:3 and 3)
RESET F, df and p on the dummy-trap model (anova.lm of the augmented fit)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 150 and 120: statistics 1e-6 relative; p-values also 1e-12 absolute; df exact; the first principal component is checked by its properties (unit norm, cov(Z) v = lambda_max v within 1e-10, scores = Z v, sign invariance)

deviations.quantity: RESET statistic and df2 on an aliased model
deviations.note: lmtest::resettest uses df2 = n - (ncol(X) + q) = 113, counting the aliased column; p2a uses n - rank = 114, as anova.lm (rule 4)

methods.name: Wald F test of nested OLS models: duplicates, strict subsets, rank-based restrictions
quantities: Chisq = q F (identity with the pinned F)
errors for non-strict subsets and rank-equal models
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 120 and 200: statistics 1e-6 relative; p-values also 1e-12 absolute; df exact

methods.name: Breusch-Godfrey and Breusch-Pagan tests on an aliased model
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 120: statistics 1e-6 relative; p-values also 1e-12 absolute
